observations: Photo 0 shows a full-size Yamaha electronic keyboard with many keys and a large control panel; brand text “YAMAHA” is visible on the left side.
Photo 1 shows the top/control side with many buttons, sliders, and a display area; no clear model number is readable.
Photo 2 shows the opposite side angle with more controls and the “YAMAHA” branding near the bottom-left; keys appear intact but there’s no close-up of damage.

claims.claim: Quality and good Yamaha keyboard for children
claims.evidence: Photos show a Yamaha keyboard, but do not prove it is in good working condition or suitable specifically for children.

risks.risk: Unknown model and feature set (affects value). The model number/series is not readable in the provided photos.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model label/serial plate (usually on the back or underside) and/or the model name shown on the front panel.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used Yamaha electronic keyboard with unknown model/age (worst-case value for an unverified model).

risks.risk: Functionality not confirmed (keys, sound, speakers, power, buttons/sliders). Photos cannot confirm it works.
risks.proof: Short video of power-on and a demo: press several keys, change a few settings/buttons, and show volume/sound output.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested / possibly not working (worst-case for remote buying).

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power adapter, stand, sustain pedal, manuals).
risks.proof: Photo of everything included laid out (adapter, pedals, stand if any) and confirmation of what is included in the sale.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming only the keyboard is included (worst-case for missing accessories).

risks.risk: Physical condition issues not visible (cracked casing, stuck keys, damaged control knobs, corrosion).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of: keybed (top and bottom), each end of the keyboard, and the control panel buttons/sliders; plus any visible scuffs/repairs.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming average used condition with possible cosmetic wear (worst-case within what photos suggest).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the model label/serial plate (back/underside) so the exact Yamaha model can be identified.
Video: power-on + sound demo (play keys, show volume working, and demonstrate a few buttons/sliders).
Photos of included accessories (power adapter, sustain pedal, stand, cables/manuals) and confirmation of what’s included.
response.reason: I can confirm it’s a Yamaha electronic keyboard from the photos, but the exact model and working condition are not verifiable remotely; without those, a safe worst-case price can’t be set confidently.
